simulator.note: Boots as M3503 rev B with 128 MB DDR3 (chips/m3503.py, run_dump_piccollino_led_app_starts.py, run_dump_piccollino_led_capture_screen.py): the XIP bootloader ("M3511E 1.1.1") runs with CacheAsRam at 0x8FFF8000..0x8FFFFFFF, prints "CH455 panel init OK!" and writes " ON " to the CH455 front panel on GPIO 135 (SCL) / 134 (SDA), parks the SEE boot stub at 0xA1416804, unpacks seecode ("M3606 SEE") to 0x86000200 and maincode(AV) to 0x80000200, and starts both cores (EBase 0x80002000 / 0x86002001).  The application prints "---led 455 attach OK--" and "Starting mcas v.1.0", updates the CH455 display to " on ", populates userdb(64+64) at 0x73FF80, and draws its 1280x720 OSD dialog on GMA layer 0 (9 GE commands, 4 colours).

desc: Edision Piccollino LED (System ID 10040800) firmware v.2475 (2019-07-10) on an 8 MB SPI flash for the ALi M3511E / M3503 rev B Full HD DVB-S2 satellite receiver with 128 MB DDR3.
Pairs dual-CPU M3503 maincode + seecode ("M3606 SEE" at 0x86000200) with a CH455 4-digit LED panel on GPIO 135 / 134 (" ON " -> " on ") and a 60-entry 0x60xx remote control table ("necfirst" coding).
